summary: Krishiva backend end-to-end tested via external EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. 33/33 pytest assertions pass covering auth (register/login/me/patch/JWT 401), users (list/search/get/no _id leak), posts (6 seeded, tag & user_id filter, liked_by_me flag both auth & anon, create+posts_count increment, like toggle, 403 non-owner delete, 200 owner delete), comments (list + create + count increment), messaging (send/list conversations/history in order/self-block/unknown-user), articles (6 seeded, by id, 404), AI (POST /api/ai/chat_sync with Gemini 3 Flash returns real farming answer and persists both user + assistant messages in db.ai_messages verifiable via /api/ai/history), duplicate-email 400, invalid-token 401, and a dedicated no-ObjectId-leak scan across /auth/me, /users, /posts, /articles, /conversations.
action_items: test_credentials.md is empty — please populate it with the seeded demo accounts (ravi@krishiva.in, ananya@krishiva.in, suresh@krishiva.in, meera@krishiva.in; password test1234) so future testing/fork agents pick them up automatically.
Consider adding pagination (skip/offset) on GET /api/posts and GET /api/users — currently only limit is supported. Not blocking.
Optional: expose the seeded article ids in a more RESTful way (currently hard-coded ids a1..a6 in server.py); acceptable for v1.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 777 lines — within limits but nearing the 700-line soft cap; consider splitting into routers/{auth,posts,messaging,ai,articles}.py in v2.
GET /api/posts parses the JWT inline instead of reusing get_current_user (necessary because auth is optional there); logic is correct and safe.
forgot-password returns the OTP in the response for dev convenience — clearly commented as dev-only. Must be removed before production.
All Mongo reads use projection {'_id': 0} — confirmed no ObjectId leaks in any tested endpoint.
Passwords hashed with bcrypt (per-hash salt via bcrypt.gensalt()), JWT HS256 with configurable expiry — solid.
seed_data_creation: Did not re-run seed.py; verified the 4 seeded users, 6 posts, 6 comments and 6 articles are present and reachable through the public API. A handful of TEST_ users were created via POST /auth/register during testing — they use example.com email addresses and can be cleaned by re-running /app/backend/seed.py which currently only clears users whose email matches @krishiva.in.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green against external URL https://verified-harvest.preview.emergentagent.com. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_krishiva_backend.py as the regression suite. Note: pydantic EmailStr rejects .test / .local TLDs — always use example.com/example.org in test payloads. The AI test hits real Gemini 3 Flash via emergentintegrations and takes ~3-5s; keep timeouts >=60s. Seeded post ids change every seed run, so tests fetch them dynamically.
